Subtract 10 weeks and 1 day = 71 days.  
1138 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
October 29, 1138 minus 71 days:  
October has 31 days, so back to September 29 is 30 days (Oct 29 → Sep 29).  
Remaining 41 days: September has 30 days, so Sep 29 → Aug 19 is 41 days (11 days back into August: 30 - 11 = Aug 19).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1138-08-19
